description:
Overview 

 Volunteer at the Esri Developer Summit to experience the most technical Esri conference alongside some of the world’s leading GIS developers!

 Esri’s Developer Summit invites professionals from a variety of technical roles, including developers, system architects, DevOps engineers, and more, to discover and discuss why ArcGIS is the leading enterprise-ready platform for developing, configuring, and automating geospatial solutions.

 In exchange for volunteering half of their time, Esri student assistants can attend technical sessions, network with technical GIS users and developers from around the world, and gain cutting-edge updates on the ArcGIS platform.

 Watch this video to see what the DevSummit Student Assistantship experience is all about: Esri Developer Summit Student Assistantship Program .

 Responsibilities 

 Student assistant responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

 
 Supporting conference registration

 Aiding conference logistics

 Working in the Esri Merch Store

 And more

 
 What's in it for you?   

 
 Complimentary registration to the 2027 Esri Developer Summit in Palm Springs, CA

 Fully compensated hotel accommodations

 Per Diem allowance for meals 

 Access to the latest updates in GIS technology

 Networking opportunities with like-minded GIS users and professionals

 
 Requirements 

 In order to qualify for Esri’s student assistantship program, students must be:

 
 Currently enrolled in a US-based community college or university

 Graduating in 2027 or later

 Passionate about GIS, Computer Science, and/or geospatial solutions

 Available to arrive and volunteer in Palm Springs, CA from Monday, March 8 – Friday, March 12, 2027

 
 Application Requirements: 

 
 Please submit a resume that highlights your GIS and Computer Science experience via RippleMatch

 Following submission of your application, Esri’s University Programs team will determine eligibility, and if applicable, will follow up with next steps to complete your application

 
 Application and Selection Timeline: 

 
 Applications collected through December 1 st , 2026

 Selection and acceptance notifications in January 2027

 
 Applications must be submitted by  December 1, 2026
